ticker: Jordan sentences three to death over church attack
SpaceX Starship successfully returns from orbit
Yemeni forces withdraw from Bab el-Mandeb Strait
US Army officer arrested over alleged Russian espionage
India beats New Zealand to seal ODI series

articles.headline: Jordan sentences three men to death over church attack
articles.brief: A Jordanian court has handed down death sentences to three men convicted for their roles in a deadly church attack, delivering a stern message against sectarian violence and bolstering security measures across the region.

articles.headline: Yemeni government forces withdraw from Bab el-Mandeb area
articles.brief: Yemeni government forces have pulled back from a strategic area near the critical Bab el-Mandeb Strait, leaving Houthi forces in control of the vital maritime chokepoint and sparking new international shipping security concerns.

articles.headline: SpaceX Starship aces orbital test by returning to pad
articles.brief: SpaceX achieved a major milestone in reusable rocket technology as the Starship spacecraft successfully returned from orbit and executed a precision landing on the pad, advancing commercial spaceflight capabilities.

articles.headline: Modi's office summons telecom secretary over fake orders
articles.brief: The Prime Minister's Office in India has summoned the top telecom secretary following an alarming security breach involving the circulation and utilization of fabricated court orders within administrative channels.

articles.headline: India's Sooryavanshi becomes youngest men's T20 captain
articles.brief: Young cricketer Sooryavanshi has etched his name in sports history by becoming the youngest captain in men's T20 cricket history, showcasing exceptional leadership potential at a remarkably tender age.

articles.headline: Bahrain intercepts Iranian aerial attacks near US base
articles.brief: Bahraini defense forces successfully intercepted multiple incoming Iranian aerial attacks amid Tehran's claims of targeting a regional US military installation, sharply escalating Gulf security tensions.

articles.headline: Owner of minibus in Assam accident arrested
articles.brief: Police in Assam have arrested the owner of a minibus involved in a horrific crash near Kaziranga National Park that killed 26 people, following suspicions that mandatory speed regulators were tampered with.

articles.headline: Delhi airport taxi trips plunge 80% due to BS-VI curbs
articles.brief: Strict BS-VI environmental regulations have caused daily cab arrivals from neighboring states at Delhi airport to drop from over 100,000 to fewer than 20,000, severely disrupting regional transport trade.

articles.headline: Fertilizer demand to recover, but water stress clouds outlook
articles.brief: While increased government subsidies are expected to revive fertilizer demand during the rabi season following a weak kharif period, critically depleted southern water reservoirs threaten full agricultural recovery.

articles.headline: Government health spending triples, lowering household burden
articles.brief: A new government report reveals public healthcare expenditure has nearly tripled over the past decade, successfully driving down out-of-pocket medical expenses for households from 64.2% to 42.7%.

articles.headline: AIIMS performs India's first foetal surgery for nerve damage
articles.brief: Doctors at AIIMS Delhi have successfully completed India's first-of-its-kind intrauterine surgery on an unborn baby to prevent permanent spinal nerve damage, marking a historic breakthrough in fetal medicine.

articles.headline: China's 19-seat electric passenger plane completes maiden flight
articles.brief: China has marked a major aviation milestone with the successful maiden flight of the CE-25A, a 19-seat electric passenger aircraft featuring advanced distributed propulsion and a 400-kilometer range.

articles.headline: US Army officer arrested in UK over Russian espionage
articles.brief: Lieutenant Colonel Brandon Carroll Tyner has been detained in the United Kingdom under suspicion of passing classified intelligence to Russian handlers in a joint operation involving the FBI and British counter-terrorism.

articles.headline: India secures preferential US market access under trade pact
articles.brief: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced that India is poised to secure favorable market access with substantially lower tariffs than competing rivals under the upcoming bilateral trade framework.

articles.headline: India defeats New Zealand to clinch ODI cricket series
articles.brief: A disciplined bowling performance powered India to defend a modest total of 209 against New Zealand, securing a 22-run victory and clinching a thrilling one-day international series triumph away from home.
